request.action: Animate only this same smith forging the visible grey iron PLATE clamped in his tongs. Keep the plate solid, rectangular, opaque grey and fixed at waist height in EVERY frame; keep the tongs gripping its right edge. The hammer head must visibly CONTACT the broad upper surface of the plate before ANY sparks. Ordered phases: 1 wind-up, grey unlit plate, no sparks; 2 hammer touches plate, NO sparks yet; 3 hammer rebounds off the plate and only THEN a tiny brief burst of orange sparks appears at the contact point; 4 sparks disappear, hammer returns. Never hit empty air or the tong jaws. No flames, glowing plate, body lighting or pre-impact effects. Fixed feet, camera, size, face, clothing, transparency and pixel style. Seamless loop. One compact precise tap, a small rebound, then recover to the starting pose.
